ev_range.evidence: EV_FAILURE_PREDICTION has no range_km or measured consumption column
ev_range.reason: No measured driving-range target exists in the EV dataset. Range can only be calculated from rated pack energy, SOH and an assumed consumption rate; it cannot be validated for accuracy against ground truth.

next_cycle_soh.reason: All three active Member 1 datasets are snapshot tables. EV has one row per vehicle, solid-state one row per cell, and synthetic at most two conflicting snapshots per battery. No chronological cycle history exists.

rul.evidence: SOLID_STATE_TELEMETRY_2026 projected cycle life is a projection; EV predicted_remaining_life_cycles is a model output. The legacy NMC PADM experiment remains preserved but is not an active-data result.
rul.reason: No active dataset contains an observed degradation trajectory to end of life. projected_cycle_life_80pct_soh and predicted_remaining_life_cycles are supplied projections, not observed RUL labels.

seq_chemistry_transfer.evidence: EV 82 cols, solid-state 41 cols, synthetic 20 cols; grains differ
seq_chemistry_transfer.reason: Cross-chemistry transfer learning needs compatible feature schemas and enough entities per chemistry. The three snapshots use different grains and columns, so a single shared sequence model would be fabricated.
